name: dokimasia
description: Compiles a frontend's routes, actions and guards into a coverage denominator, imports a reviewed UAT workbook without losing a row, drafts a disposition set a reviewer edits rather than authors, and counts only the entries a person confirmed; a closure ratio states that nothing is unaccounted for, never that anything passed.

interface.shortDescription: Compiles a frontend's routes, actions and guards into a coverage denominator, imports a reviewed UAT workbook without losing a row, drafts a disposition set a reviewer edits rather than authors, and counts only the entries a person confirmed; a closure ratio states that nothing is unaccounted for, never that anything passed.
interface.longDescription: Dokimasia answers the question a release spreadsheet cannot: which of an application's routes, actions and access guards has no reviewed oracle. It compiles the inventory from a pinned commit, imports the reviewed workbook without losing a row's identity, drafts an unconfirmed disposition for every scoped item, and reconciles both sides so every item carries exactly one disposition. Only an entry a named person confirmed, under any rule they applied, counts toward the closure ratio; every substantive verb refuses an input it cannot pin. It reports a closure ratio and a gap list for one pinned commit, and will never report an item as covered without a reviewed oracle a person wrote.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dokimasia to scrutinise a pinned frontend checkout against its reviewed UAT workbook and state which scoped items carry no disposition and whose confirmation each counted entry rests on.
